title: Blue Mountain Beach "Hidden Lake Condominium" 3986 West County Highway 30A Unit 233
h1: Blue Mountain Beach "Hidden Lake Condominium" 3986 West County Highway 30A Unit 233
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Walking distance from the beach- Gulf views- Community pool- Fitness Center- Extended stays allowed- 2 Parking spots- Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Set course for gorgeous beaches and laid-back living at Hidden Lake Condominium, a 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom Blue Mountain Beach retreat that sleeps up to 8 guests. Guests of this condo will love relaxing on the covered balcony, taking advantage of the community pool, and strolling to the beach—only 6 minutes away! Tucked in the heart of Scenic 30A, Shunk Galley, Goatfeathers, and Papa Surf are all within walking distance. This Gulf destination is steeped in beauty, from the sun-soaked beaches and unique dune lakes to the local artist studios that give this area its groovy reputation. Enjoy days of in-, on-, and off-the-water fun, topped with cool treats from the famous Blue Mountain Beach Creamery.Cerulean splashes and shiplap walls add a touch of stylish seaside inspiration throughout this contemporary single-story condo. In the living space, a comfortable sofa and 2 accent chairs face the TV for nights of entertainment. Behind the sofa is a spacious dining table for 6, where guests can savor meals prepared in the adjacent modern kitchen. A sleek 3-stool breakfast bar offers extra seating or a spot to socialize while helping the chef of the group with food prep. The glass door off the living area leads onto a vast, sheltered balcony. Unwind in the fresh air with a rich cup of coffee or a nightcap from the comfort of the plush patio seating. When the evening ends, retire to the primary bedroom, featuring a soft king bed, private bathroom, and balcony access, or enjoy a peaceful night’s rest in the guest bedroom with a queen bed. The bunk room’s twin-over-full bunk bed and twin trundle are perfect for kids. Light packers will appreciate the convenient laundry room with a stacked washer and dryer.With a community pool and 2 beach accesses within walking distance, Hidden Lake Condominium is a delightful Blue Mountain Beach escape. Parking for 2 vehicles makes it easy to explore. For beach access, choose between Spooky Lane (6 min.) and Gulfview Heights (7 min.), which has a lifeguard on duty in Summer. Simply head down West County Highway 30A, turn onto the respective street, and the beach will be at the end of the road. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 8):- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Twin-over-Full Bunk Bed and Twin Trundle, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo*Guests who are 25 years of age or younger must be accompanied by a responsible parent or guardian in any vacation rental managed by Callista by 360 Blue. We do not rent homes to those 25 years of age or younger who are unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian. Moreover, there must be a ratio of at least (1) parent or guardian over the age of 25 for every four (4) young adults who are 25 years of age or younger.
